description: Each city's count is its number of distinct races with qualifying data (qualifying sessions), and its share is its share of all such sessions.

b.request: For each circuit city, identify the number of distinct races with qualifying data, calculate that count as a share of total qualifying sessions across all cities, and return only cities whose share exceeds the average share per city, showing: city name, qualifying session count, that count as a percentage of all qualifying sessions, and the percentage-point difference above the average city share.
b.sql:
WITH city_race_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.raceId) AS race_count
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(race_count) AS total_races,
    COUNT(*) AS num_cities,
    100.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_percentage
  FROM city_race_counts
)
SELECT 
  crc.location,
  crc.race_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * crc.race_count / s.total_races, 2) AS percentage,
  ROUND(100.0 * crc.race_count / s.total_races - s.avg_percentage, 2) AS percentage_point_diff
FROM city_race_counts crc
CROSS JOIN summary s
WHERE 100.0 * crc.race_count / s.total_races > s.avg_percentage
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

c.request: Which circuit cities have an above-average share of qualifying? For each, show the city, its qualifying count, that count as a share of the total across all cities, and how far its share is above the average city share (all unrounded). Each city's count is its number of distinct races with qualifying data (qualifying sessions), and its share is its share of all such sessions.
c.sql: WITH qualifying_races_by_city AS (SELECT c.location as city, COUNT(DISTINCT q.raceId) as qualifying_count FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.location), totals AS (SELECT SUM(qualifying_count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_cities FROM qualifying_races_by_city) SELECT qrc.city, qrc.qualifying_count, CAST(qrc.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share, CAST(qrc.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count - 1.0 / t.num_cities as above_average FROM qualifying_races_by_city qrc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE CAST(qrc.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count > 1.0 / t.num_cities ORDER BY above_average DESC

d.request: For each circuit city, count the distinct races with qualifying records, express that count as a share (percentage) of the total qualifying sessions across all cities, and report the percentage point difference between this city's share and the average city share (all unrounded).
d.sql:
WITH city_qualifying AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) as race_count
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(race_count) as total_races FROM city_qualifying
),
city_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cq.location,
    cq.race_count,
    100.0 * cq.race_count / t.total_races as percentage_share
  FROM city_qualifying cq
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(percentage_share) as avg_share FROM city_shares
)
SELECT 
  cs.location,
  cs.race_count,
  cs.percentage_share,
  cs.percentage_share - ashr.avg_share as percentage_point_difference
FROM city_shares cs
CROSS JOIN average_share ashr
ORDER BY cs.location

a.request: For each circuit city (`circuits.location`), count the distinct races held there that have qualifying data, and work out the city's share as that count divided by the total across all cities. List the cities whose share is above the average share across cities, showing the city, the count, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, all unrounded.
a.sql:
WITH distinct_qualifying_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT raceId
  FROM qualifying
),
city_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location,
    COUNT(*) as race_count
  FROM distinct_qualifying_races q
  INNER JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
total_races AS (
  SELECT SUM(race_count) as total FROM city_counts
),
city_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.location,
    cc.race_count,
    CAST(cc.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total as share
  FROM city_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN total_races tr
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM city_shares
)
SELECT 
  cs.location as city,
  cs.race_count as count,
  cs.share,
  cs.share - s.average_share as above_average
FROM city_shares cs
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE cs.share > s.average_share
ORDER BY cs.share DESC
